title: Die Leere zwischen den Zeilen — a loose thread the pointer drags
note: A thin 1px grey line hangs down the page through the title. It behaves like a thread: it bends and lags behind the pointer, loops around the words and settles slowly when you stop, so the cover never looks the same twice. It is drawn as a polyline (Readymag, alongside Lottie masks), not a canvas. Worth reusing: a drawn hairline as cursor feedback. Quieter than a trail of images, and it literally draws lines between the words, which is the site's subject.
